revision.scope: One reduced-coordinate COMPLETE115-knot formulation. Eliminate rootxy+12leg angles using all14 original per-knot fixed-foot/COM equations at each function evaluation; retain206 independent descent/orientation phases, force-null coordinates and114times. Initial and endpoint/load poses exact. One max30iteration SLSQP, not restarted. Dependent Newton max10iterations/9halvings,1e-13 numerical residual; domain failure terminates the one solve and preserves last valid candidate. Implicit-function derivatives, explicit original dependent joint/root bounds, original static command/effort/corner/phase/rate/headroom/hover/normal/time constraints. Hover equality divided by12mm for numerical scaling; original12mm guard unchanged. Original full geometry mandatory final rejection. No runtime, extra feedback authority, physics or policy training.
